Kind of number: the authors' extended data (2026-09-28) states that Table I lists the best of ten checkpoints (every 150 of 1500 epochs), each a 4096-sample estimate; no error bar is printed, so sigma stays null (RULES.md 6). Sits 2.89e-4 per site above the instance's exact row 'Exact diagonalization' (-0.506588 per site).
